# Problem statement

Reproduce the two-lens arrangement. S is an isotropic point source, 24 cm left of L1 and 1.2 cm above the common optical axis. L1 and L2 are coaxial ideal converging thin lenses separated by 28 cm. Their focal lengths are +8 cm and +12 cm; their full aperture heights are 20 cm and 24 cm respectively. Use the labels, not pixel distances.
